domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the original denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator for unlike fractions.
Tag when one or both fractional parts are converted to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
Tag for both pure-fraction and mixed-number subtraction when denominator matching is the main purpose of the step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/d unless the step's main purpose is denominator matching already captured elsewhere.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping or final simplification.

skills.name: Normalize subtraction form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into an equivalent subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero fractional part or converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a denominator to set up mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the step's main purpose is preparatory rewriting of the quantities before subtraction begins.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag common-denominator conversion between unlike denominators; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag direct subtraction once the quantities are already in workable form.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after a negative or insufficient fractional difference appears.
Do not tag final simplification of the result.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the solution computes an intermediate negative fractional difference before any regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is creating common denominators or preparatory rewriting.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping used to repair a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag simplification to lowest terms or final-format rewriting unless actual subtraction is performed in that step.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow 1 whole into fractional units when needed and express the result in lowest terms or appropriate whole-number/mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed/regrouped into denominator-over-denominator or equivalent fractional units to continue subtraction.
Tag when a fraction or mixed number result is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fraction is rewritten as 0 or when a result is expressed as a whole number or mixed number in final form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0/d; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag finding a common denominator; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction that requires neither regrouping nor simplification.
